title: Introduction to Python
description: What Python is and how to make the computer show a message on the screen.

content.value: Python is a programming language. A programming language is just a way to give a computer instructions, one step at a time. The computer follows those steps exactly, in order, from top to bottom.
Python is popular because it is easy to read. Many of the instructions look almost like plain English. People use Python to build websites, make games, work with data, and much more.
The most common first instruction is `print`. It tells the computer to show something on the screen. You write `print`, then a pair of parentheses `()`, and put your message inside quotation marks.

print("Hello, World!")
print("I am learning Python!")
Each `print` line shows one message. The two lines above show two lines of text, one after the other.
Text that you want shown on screen always needs quotation marks around it (" "). Without them, Python doesn't know it's text and gives an error.

practice.question: Use print to make the computer show your name.

quiz.question: What does `print` do?
options: It prints paper from a printer.
It shows text on the screen.
quiz.explain: `print` shows text or numbers on the screen. It has nothing to do with a paper printer.
